# Sanctuary Repository Instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for repository commands and project-specific workflows.

[`docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md`](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md) is the canonical source for coding, architecture, security, database, UI, accessibility, testing, and definition-of-done requirements.
